jobs.name: debate-ab-cleanctx-rlvrs20
jobs.command:
set -euo pipefail
export POD_IDLE_STOP=0
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
unset HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER
export HF_HOME=/workspace/hf
# The profile's setup restores exactly ONE of these, and WHICH one is not
# knowable here: debate-b200x2 ladders to debate-h200x2, and the two ship
# different arch-pinned tarballs (verl-b200 vs verl-sm90). A hardcoded path
# turns a routine REBOUND into an instant failure on the substitute pod.
PY=""
for v in verl-b200 verl-sm90; do
  if [ -x "/workspace/envs/$v/bin/python" ]; then PY="/workspace/envs/$v/bin/python"; break; fi
done
test -n "$PY" || { echo "FATAL: no verl env under /workspace/envs" >&2; ls -la /workspace/envs >&2; exit 1; }
export PY
echo "== using $PY =="
export CONFIG=configs/math_pc_debate.yaml
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name --format=csv,noheader

export DEBATE_LAUNCH_NAMESPACE=ab-cleanctx-01

# --- warm start from the RLVR control's step 20 ----------------------------
# MERGED into base rather than continued as an adapter, deliberately: a
# continued adapter would have the debate gradient rewriting the same
# parameters that encode the RLVR behaviour, so a later drop in correctness
# could not be told apart from debate eating its own warm start. Merging also
# leaves the full rank-32 adapter free for debate-specific learning.
#
# This checkpoint is FSDP2-SHARDED across 2 ranks -- the RLVR arm trains on 2
# GPUs, unlike the world_size_1 fmt-warmup. merge_lora_ckpt.py reassembles the
# DTensors along their own placement dim and asserts each result against the
# checkpoint's global shape; reading rank 0 alone would merge HALF of every
# LoRA matrix and raise nothing at all.
ADAPTER=/workspace/rlvr-s20-adapter
MERGED=/workspace/models/qwen35-rlvr-sub8-s20
SENTINEL=/workspace/models/.qwen35-rlvr-sub8-s20.ok
test -f "$ADAPTER/model_world_size_2_rank_0.pt"
test -f "$ADAPTER/model_world_size_2_rank_1.pt"
test -f "$ADAPTER/lora_train_meta.json"
if [ -f "$SENTINEL" ]; then
  echo "== merged base already present at $MERGED =="
else
  rm -rf "$MERGED"
  mkdir -p /workspace/models
  # Prefer a snapshot already in the pod's HF cache; download only if absent,
  # and never silence the downloader -- the first cut of the warm spec piped
  # `hf download` to /dev/null and two rented H200 attempts died saying nothing
  # when the hub refused to run at all on 2026-08-27.
  BASE_SNAP=$(ls -d "$HF_HOME"/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3.5-4B/snapshots/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
  if [ -z "${BASE_SNAP:-}" ] || [ ! -f "$BASE_SNAP/config.json" ]; then
    echo "== base snapshot not cached; downloading Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B =="
    hf download Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
    BASE_SNAP=$(ls -d "$HF_HOME"/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3.5-4B/snapshots/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
  fi
  test -n "${BASE_SNAP:-}" || { echo "FATAL: no Qwen3.5-4B snapshot under $HF_HOME" >&2; ls -la "$HF_HOME/hub" >&2 2>/dev/null; exit 1; }
  test -f "$BASE_SNAP/config.json" || { echo "FATAL: $BASE_SNAP has no config.json" >&2; ls -la "$BASE_SNAP" >&2; exit 1; }
  echo "== base snapshot: $BASE_SNAP =="
  echo "== merging $ADAPTER into $BASE_SNAP =="
  "$PY" scripts/merge_lora_ckpt.py --ckpt "$ADAPTER" --base "$BASE_SNAP" --out "$MERGED" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/merge.log
  # 346 pairs, of which 248 carry a nonzero lora_B -- measured on this exact
  # checkpoint locally before submission. Asserting the number pins WHICH
  # adapter was folded in, and 'unmatched: 0' catches an adapter that disagrees
  # with the base about the model rather than merging partially in silence.
  grep -q 'applied 346 deltas; unmatched: 0' /tmp/merge.log \
    || { echo "FATAL: unexpected merge result" >&2; cat /tmp/merge.log >&2; exit 1; }
  touch "$SENTINEL"
fi
test -f "$MERGED/config.json"

# a cancelled attempt can strand its detached judge on 8788
pkill -9 -f -- '--port 8788' 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 3
bash scripts/pod_run.sh debate mathl5_qwen35_pc_debate_cispo_verl_sub8_kenton_rlvrs20
